title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This page reports the engines' own state from the running record. Every position here is paper: no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade says nothing about a strategy. The live record starts 1 October 2026 for v005 and 9 October 2026 for v006. The snapshot below was read at 2026-11-06T20:37:41.221Z.

## What is open

The only open position named in the record is a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026, which has been open since. Everything else is flat on paper:

- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: 0 positions open on paper.

The rule behind those zeros is visible in the market filter section: with the filter off, the trend-daily engines are not taking new positions, so an open position exists only where one was already taken, as with NEAR.

## What closed

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The exit rule was a close below the 10-day low, and that is what happened: ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The cause was the rule firing on a weak close, the measurement was the 1.703 exit, and the result was the −17.9% net figure.

The engines' closed-trade counts and averages are:

- htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 6, average -13.22% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 7, average -13.34% net per trade.

In testing, losses were more common than wins and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a statement about the test distribution, not a promise about these live results.

## Market filter

Both trend-daily engines currently have the Bitcoin market filter off, and both hold 0 positions open on paper:

- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off, and 0 positions are open on paper.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off, and 0 positions are open on paper.

With the filter off, neither trend-daily engine is taking new positions; the record only shows how close each tracked symbol is to its 20-day breakout. The distances are:

- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: ZECUSDT is 2.63% below its high.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: BCHUSDT is 8.00% below its high.
- trend-daily-v005 closest to its 20-day breakout: BNBUSDT is 9.23% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: ZECUSDT is 2.63% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: BCHUSDT is 8.00% below its high.
- trend-daily-v006 closest to its 20-day breakout: BNBUSDT is 9.23% below its high.

The cause is the filter state, the measurement is the distance to the 20-day high, and the consequence is that no new trend-daily entry can be taken while the filter stays off, regardless of how close a symbol is to its breakout.

## Where to check

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the open positions, closed-trade counts, averages, and filter state can change as new daily closes are processed.
